coverage: per-wall XR/photo/Deep 2D coverage grids; AR overlay red/yellow/green; multiple partial photos can cover one long/narrow wall
viewer: orthographic/isometric textured shell; selectable OBB object manager; bare-room mode; PLY/OBJ import
objects: persistent non-structural XR/Deep residual -> connected voxels -> gravity-aligned PCA OBB + compact RGB point cloud
